name: kanban
description: Kanban Board is a visual task and project management board for organizing work, prioritizing tasks, and moving cards through a clear workflow.

interface.longDescription: Kanban Board is a focused visual board for organizing tasks and projects. Create a clear workflow for to-do, in-progress, review, and completed work, prioritize tasks, and keep projects moving. Useful for personal productivity, software development, Agile and Scrum planning, project tracking, content workflows, and lightweight team task management.
defaultPrompt: Open my Kanban board for project planning.
Help me organize my tasks on the Kanban board.
